title: This, here, in: naming and placing things

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Name a thing with *ez* (this) or *az* (that) and *egy*: *Ez egy asztal.* There is no "is" when you only name it. To say where something is, use *itt* (here), *ott* (there) and *van*; *nincs* means there is none. For "in" the ending goes on the place: *-ban* after back vowels, *-ben* after front vowels. "The" is *a*, or *az* before a vowel.

items.english: The key is in the room.

sections.content: Never add *van* when you only name a thing: *Ez egy asztal*, not *Ez van egy asztal*. Use *van* when you say where it is.
